description: This file defines the CommentsController class for handling HTTP requests related to comments within the Conduit project. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments associated with articles, utilizing mediator pattern for request handling.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller class handling comment-related API endpoints with dependency injection of mediator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by ID from an article identified by slug.
